params.body:
The README, read against the code. Only stale claims corrected and missing essentials added; language and structure kept. Every change with the file and line that justifies it:

# README review: ShaneDeconinck/vlamingdam-frituur

Compared README.md (HEAD e0f7777) against the repository. Changes in README.new.md:

- README.md:6, knop "Afdrukken": the button reads "Menukaart afdrukken (A4 liggend)" (src/pages/index.astro:41). Corrected to "Menukaart afdrukken", the wording the Afdrukken section already used.
- README.md:6-7 implied only `/beheer` is behind the code. Stale: src/middleware.ts:3-5 and :16-27 redirect every non-authed request (except `/beheer`, `/_*`, `/favicon*`, `/robots.txt`) to `/beheer`. Added a paragraph saying the whole site is gated. Also noted that without `BEHEER_CODE` a default from src/middleware.ts:10 (same in src/pages/beheer.astro:12 and src/actions/index.ts:9) applies; the value itself is not repeated in the README.
- README.md:11, stack line: added "server output, Netlify-adapter" (astro.config.mjs: `output: "server"`, `adapter: netlify()`).
- README.md:15-20, Lokaal draaien: added Node 24 (.github/workflows/test.yml and deploy.yml `node-version: 24`) and that scripts load `.env.local` via `--env-file` (package.json scripts `dev`, `build`, `preview` use `--env-file-if-exists=.env.local`).
- Missing: no test section. Added "Testen" with `npm test`, `npm run test:coverage` (package.json scripts), what they cover (vitest.config.ts: environment node, include `tests/**/*.test.ts`, coverage include `src/lib/**/*.ts`, exclude seed-data.ts and types.ts, reporter json-summary), and that `npm run build` works without Sanity keys (test.yml comment on the build step).
- README.md:26, "Kopieer `.env.local.example` naar `.env.local`": stale. No `.env.local.example` exists in the repo (`ls -a` shows none) and `.gitignore` line `.env*` excludes it from ever being committed. Replaced with "Maak `.env.local` aan" and the reason.
- README.md:27-29, env list: added optional `SANITY_DATASET` (default `production`) and `SANITY_API_VERSION` (default `2024-01-01`), from src/lib/sanity.ts:5-7.
- README.md:32-35, seed: added that `npm run seed` requires `.env.local` to exist (package.json `seed` uses `--env-file=.env.local`, not `--env-file-if-exists`).
- README.md:39-41, Afdrukken: added the "Veilige printmarge" checkbox (default on, 8 mm) and `/?randloos=1` for borderless, from src/pages/index.astro:19-24 and :42-45. Existing instructions kept.
- README.md:45-50, Deployen: stale as the only path. `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` deploys on push to `main` (and workflow_dispatch) after `test.yml` passes, using `netlify-cli deploy --build --prod` with secrets `NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN` and `NETLIFY_SITE_ID`; deploy.yml comment says the Sanity/BEHEER env vars live on the Netlify site itself. Manual command kept. Added netlify.toml settings (`npm run build`, publish `dist`).
- Missing: CI and Elixir. Added "CI en Elixir" section describing test.yml (push main, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, workflow_call; test:coverage, build, `abovebeyond-ai/elixir-quality@v1` with `coverage/coverage-summary.json`), deploy.yml, elixir-fix.yml (workflow_dispatch with plan/evidence/capability inputs, `abovebeyond-ai/elixir-fix/.github/workflows/fix.yml@v1`, test `npm run test:coverage`), evidence.yml (pull_request to main, `if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'elixir/')`, `abovebeyond-ai/control-verify-action@v1` mode pull).
- Missing: elixir.json. Added: one environment, production `https://vlamingdam-frituur.netlify.app` (elixir.json). Stated there is no `/up`, `/.well-known/build.json` or `/api/elixir` (grep over src, scripts, .github, netlify.toml finds none; src/pages has only index.astro and beheer.astro).

Unchanged and verified true:

- README.md:3-4, 7-9 (ShopEditor block and CategoryEditor on /beheer: src/pages/beheer.astro:59-60 and components).
- README.md:12-13, seed-data fallback (src/lib/data.ts:9-11, src/lib/sanity.ts:10).
- README.md:19, port 4321 (Astro default; astro.config.mjs sets no other port).
- README.md:22-25, Sanity setup steps (dataset default `production`, write token needed by src/lib/sanity.ts:25-30).
- README.md:32-33, seed flags (scripts/seed.ts:3-7 and :14, :26).
- README.md:54-59, Allergenen block (src/pages/beheer.astro:53-54 describes the same click cycle). Its "→" arrows are original text and were left as is.

Surprises outside the README:

- scripts/seed.ts:9 says `.env.local` needs `NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID`, but src/lib/sanity.ts:5 reads `SANITY_PROJECT_ID`. The README is right; the code comment is stale.
- AGENTS.md (included by CLAUDE.md) contains only Next.js agent rules, and .gitignore is Next.js-flavoured (`.next/`, `next-env.d.ts`), while the project is Astro. Leftovers from a Next.js start.
- The workflows use `npm install` instead of `npm ci` because the lockfile was made on macOS and misses linux-only optional deps (comment in test.yml and deploy.yml).

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: README: read against the code
